questions.question: The Peninsular Plateau is composed of old crystalline, igneous, and metamorphic rocks, formed due to the breaking and drifting of which landmass?

How does the Swachh Bharat Abhiyan (SBA) aim to achieve its goals?
options: Through the promotion of cleanliness and the construction of toilets to eliminate open defecation
By implementing high taxes on pollution-causing industries
Through the distribution of free healthcare services
By focusing solely on the construction of physical infrastructure like roads and bridges
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Through the promotion of cleanliness and the construction of toilets to eliminate open defecation) है।
